Viral hepatitis is a global public-health challenge. According to the statistics, hepatitis and cirrhosis caused by hepatitis and acute infections cause 1.4 million deaths each year, mainly HBV, accounting for 55%. China is in the high incidence area of viral hepatitis, in which there were 20 million chronic hepatitis patients, and about 1.2 million developed cirrhosis and even liver cancer in 2018. Among them, hepatitis B, the largest proportion, accounts for about 80.5%, and hepatitis E, the smallest proportion, accounts for about 1.6%. At present, the main treatments of western medicine include taking antiviral drugs and injecting vaccines, but there are certain side effects such as poor drug resistance.
